infobox.usage: Unlocks the guard desk room on the first floor of the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm guard desk key (GDesk) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the two-story dormitory guard desk.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In the hand of the Dead Scav inside the shower on the first floor of the two-story dorms.

sections.heading: Lock Location
